$comment: MCP servers the host connects to. Requirement 6 is satisfied by flipping 'enabled' between noc-local and noc-remote: nothing else in the project changes.

servers.name: git
servers.description: Official Anthropic Git MCP server (requirement 4). Launched without --repository so each tool takes an explicit repo_path, which lets the assistant create a brand new repository during the demo.

servers.name: noc-local
servers.description: Custom ISP/NOC support desk MCP server over stdio (requirement 5)

servers.name: noc-http-local
servers.description: The same NOC server over Streamable HTTP on loopback. Used to verify the HTTP transport before deploying, and as the plaintext capture target for the Wireshark analysis (requirement 7). Start it with: npm run noc:http

servers.name: noc-remote
servers.description: The same NOC server deployed remotely over Streamable HTTP (requirement 6). Enable this and disable noc-local to exercise the remote path.
